**English** | [简体中文](#简体中文)

## LiteScriptManager v0.1.1

This release adds a self-contained updater, so a new version is no longer something you only find out about by visiting the repo, and the interface now speaks English as well as Chinese. Most of the work underneath went into two problems that made the app feel broken: starting a script could freeze the panel and always exited 1 for batch and PowerShell scripts, and the quick panel could not be dismissed at all when it never received focus.

## New

### Check for updates from inside the app

Settings → About & updates shows the current version, checks the GitHub Releases API on request, and prints the notes of a newer release with a progress bar and an install button. The tray menu gained "Check updates", and a check also runs at startup.

- The result is cached in the backend and `install_update` takes no arguments, so the UI can never hand the backend an arbitrary download URL or checksum.
- Downloads are accepted only over HTTPS from `github.com`, `api.github.com` and `githubusercontent.com`, are capped at 512 MB, must start with the `MZ` header, and are verified against an optional `<asset>.sha256` digest published next to the asset.
- `github.com` is unreachable on some networks, so the asset API endpoint is kept as a fallback; both endpoints are tried with one retry each.
- The installer is launched through `ShellExecuteW` with `/S /UPDATE /R` — the silent arguments `tauri-plugin-updater` uses — and the app exits after the command returns, so the UI can report progress instead of being killed mid-update.
- `tauri-plugin-updater` was not used because it needs a signing key pair and a JSON manifest per release; this build has neither.

### The interface is available in English

Settings → Language switches between 简体中文 and English, and the choice applies immediately — the main window, the tray panel, every dialog and the error message shown after a failed action.

- Backend error strings are mapped through a dedicated translation table, so a `friendlyError()` result reads as one sentence rather than a Chinese message with an English prefix.
- Native notifications composed on the Rust side (trigger fired, new version found, update check failed) read the stored preference and use the same language.
- The choice is cached in `localStorage` for a flicker-free first paint and stored as the `language` setting, which remains the source of truth.

### Confirmation dialogs that actually appear

Deleting a script, deleting a schedule or trigger, and clearing history used the browser's `window.confirm`, which does not show reliably in the Tauri WebView on Windows — the click did nothing at all. A shared in-app dialog replaces it, styled with the existing modal and button classes and reachable by keyboard.

## Improvements

- **Windows are created off the event-loop thread.** Creating a WebView2 window from a tray click, a global shortcut or the single-instance handler could deadlock on Windows and take the whole app with it; `show_main` and `close_panel` are now async and the remaining handlers run on a worker thread.
- **Start, stop and adopt no longer block the event loop.** They run on a blocking thread, so the window keeps painting while a process tree is being terminated.
- **A script left running from an earlier session is adopted** instead of being refused with "already running", and run handles whose process tree is gone are reaped so they stop occupying an instance slot. `pythonw.exe` is included in the adoption rules.
- **`list_scripts` derives status from live run handles** instead of a stored column, so a script that ended while the UI was closed no longer shows as running.
- **Listing WSL distros no longer flashes a console window.**
- Settings side effects are applied before a validation error is reported, so a rejected save leaves the running state consistent with what is on screen.

## Fixes

- **Batch and PowerShell scripts always exited with 1.** `canonicalize` returns a verbatim `\\?\` path, and `cmd.exe /c call` and `powershell -File` reject it with "the system cannot find the path specified". The prefix is stripped before the path is handed to an interpreter.
- **The quick panel could not be dismissed.** Dismissal was driven by a single `Focused(false)` event, and a panel that never gained focus never produced one — clicking elsewhere did nothing and the panel stayed on screen. A polling watchdog now closes it, one per panel generation so a reopened panel is not closed by a stale timer.
- **Runs cut short by an app exit were recorded as failures.** A run still open at startup had died with the previous session's Job Object, which is an interruption rather than a script failure; those rows are now written as `stopped` with reason `app_exit`.
- **Stale script status after a run ended** (see `list_scripts` above).

## Upgrading

- `LiteScriptManager_0.1.1_x64-setup.exe` is a per-user NSIS installer; no administrator rights are required. Requirements: Windows 10/11 (x64) and the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime.
- The version number was 0.2.0 in the tree for a while without being released; it is 0.1.1 here, directly after v0.1.0. Settings and history from v0.1.0 carry over — the database schema has not changed.
- The UI defaults to Simplified Chinese. Switch to English under Settings → Language.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Jaspersol/LiteScriptManager/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1

## 简体中文

## LiteScriptManager v0.1.1

这个版本加入了自带的应用内更新，新版本不再只能靠访问仓库才知道；界面也支持英文了。底层的大部分工作用来修两个让应用"像坏了一样"的问题：启动脚本会冻住面板，并且批处理和 PowerShell 脚本恒定以 1 退出；快速面板在从未获得焦点时完全无法关闭。

## 新增

### 在应用内检查更新

「设置 → 关于与更新」会显示当前版本，可按需向 GitHub Releases API 发起检查，并展示新版本的更新说明、进度条和安装按钮。托盘菜单新增「检查更新」，启动时也会自动检查一次。

- 检查结果缓存在后端，且 `install_update` 不接受任何参数，界面无法把任意下载地址或校验值交给后端。
- 下载只接受来自 `github.com`、`api.github.com`、`githubusercontent.com` 的 HTTPS 请求，上限 512 MB，文件必须以 `MZ` 头开始，并与随资源一同发布的 `<asset>.sha256` 摘要（若存在）核对。
- 部分网络无法访问 `github.com`，因此保留了 Assets API 端点作为备选；两个端点各重试一次。
- 安装包通过 `ShellExecuteW` 以 `/S /UPDATE /R` 启动，也就是 `tauri-plugin-updater` 使用的静默参数；命令返回后应用才退出，界面因此能报告进度，而不是在更新中途被杀掉。
- 没有使用 `tauri-plugin-updater`，因为它需要签名密钥对和每个版本的 JSON 清单，而这个应用两者都没有。

### 界面支持英文

「设置 → 语言」可在简体中文和英文之间切换，切换立即生效——主窗口、托盘面板、所有对话框，以及操作失败后显示的错误信息都会跟着变。

- 后端错误字符串通过一张专门的翻译表映射，因此 `friendlyError()` 的结果是一句完整的英文，而不是"英文前缀 + 中文正文"。
- 在 Rust 侧生成的原生通知（触发器已触发、发现新版本、检查更新失败）也会读取已保存的语言设置，使用同一种语言。
- 语言选择缓存在 `localStorage` 中以避免首屏闪烁，并保存为 `language` 设置项，后者仍是唯一事实来源。

### 确认对话框现在真的会出现

删除脚本、删除计划或触发器、清空历史原先使用浏览器的 `window.confirm`，而它在 Windows 上的 Tauri WebView 中并不可靠地弹出——点击后什么都不会发生。现在换成应用内的统一对话框，复用了现有的模态与按钮样式，并可用键盘操作。

## 改进

- **窗口全部在事件循环线程之外创建。** 从托盘点击、全局快捷键或单实例处理中创建 WebView2 窗口，可能在 Windows 上死锁并拖垮整个应用；`show_main` 与 `close_panel` 已改为异步，其余处理放到工作线程。
- **启动、停止、接管不再阻塞事件循环。** 它们改在阻塞线程上执行，因此终止进程树时窗口仍能正常重绘。
- **上一个会话残留的脚本进程会被接管**，而不是直接以"已在运行"拒绝；进程树已经结束的运行句柄会被回收，不再占用实例槽位。接管规则中已包含 `pythonw.exe`。
- **`list_scripts` 改为从实时运行句柄推导状态**，不再读取数据库中的旧字段，界面关闭期间结束的脚本不会再显示为"运行中"。
- **列出 WSL 发行版时不再闪出控制台窗口。**
- 保存设置失败时先执行副作用再报告错误，被拒绝的保存不会让运行状态与界面显示不一致。

## 修复

- **批处理和 PowerShell 脚本总是以 1 退出。** `canonicalize` 返回的是带 `\\?\` 前缀的 verbatim 路径，而 `cmd.exe /c call` 与 `powershell -File` 会以"系统找不到指定的路径"拒绝它。现在在把路径交给解释器之前会去掉该前缀。
- **快速面板无法关闭。** 关闭逻辑依赖一次 `Focused(false)` 事件，而从未获得焦点的面板根本不会发出该事件——点击别处没有反应，面板一直留在屏幕上。现在改用轮询看门狗关闭，并按面板代次区分，重新打开的面板不会被上一代的定时器关掉。
- **因应用退出而中断的运行被记成了失败。** 启动时仍未结束的运行，其 Job Object 已随上次会话关闭，这属于中断而不是脚本失败；这些记录现在写为 `stopped`，原因为 `app_exit`。
- **运行结束后状态残留**（见上文的 `list_scripts`）。

## 升级

- `LiteScriptManager_0.1.1_x64-setup.exe` 是按用户安装的 NSIS 安装包，无需管理员权限。要求 Windows 10/11（x64）以及 Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime。
- 版本号曾一度在代码中写作 0.2.0 但从未发布，这里定为 0.1.1，紧接 v0.1.0。v0.1.0 的设置和历史记录可直接沿用，数据库结构没有变化。
- 界面默认简体中文，可在「设置 → 语言」切换到英文。

**完整变更：** https://github.com/Jaspersol/LiteScriptManager/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1
